title: Black Bean Quesadillas
author: Claude
description: Crisp tortillas folded around spiced black beans, pepper and melted cheddar.
steps: Roughly mash the beans with the cumin and a pinch of salt.
Spread the beans over half of each tortilla, top with pepper, scallions and cheddar, and fold.
Cook in a dry pan over medium heat for 2–3 minutes per side until crisp and melted.
Cut into wedges and serve with lime.
